summary: Implemented H1 with preallocated fixed-size slot storage, tagged atomic free/published heads, release/acquire ownership transitions, and unchanged C ABI.
expected_behavior: Push reserves capacity before copying and publication; pop validates output capacity, copies before recycling, preserves LIFO order, and avoids operation-time allocation.
evidence: cargo test --locked passed 3 tests, including concurrent 4P/4C conservation and insufficient-output preservation. Release build succeeded; all 9 required vsst_* symbols exported. No framework-owned correctness or benchmark command was duplicated, so no throughput row is claimed.
candidate_retention_reason: No target-bound comparable measurement was collected; framework evaluation remains pending.
